description:
List Actions for a Primary IP

Returns all [Actions](#tag/actions) for a [Primary IP](#tag/primary-ips).

Use the provided URI parameters to modify the result.

auto_paginate.description: Auto-merge all pages up to the soft-cap. Set false to use raw page/per_page.

page.description: Page number to return. For more information, see "[Pagination](#description/pagination)".

per_page.description: Maximum number of entries returned per page. For more information, see "[Pagination](#description/pagination)".

sort.description:
Sort actions by field and direction. May be used multiple times.

For more information, see "[Sorting](#description/sorting)".

status.description:
Filter the actions by status. May be used multiple times.

The response will only contain actions matching the specified statuses.

name: hcloud_list_primary_ip_actions
